integrity.sourceCheckoutConversion: 289 LF lines -> CRLF; exact, no other byte changes

findings.finding: V1, V2 and V3 exited 1 because the fixed 1280x800 / 100 percent completion scope was unavailable before RunCompletion.
findings.source: Sealed build/r01/Program.cs:110-112 constructs dimensions from Math.Min with SystemParameters.WorkArea; lines 131-135 reject the fixed geometry/zoom precondition before calling RunCompletion.
findings.observed: All three failure-state records show initial Editor layout, Preview pending, actualWidth 1024 and actualHeight 720. Preferences show Window:null, Zoom 100 and Pages mode. Qualification-scope and presentation-completion records are absent; samples.jsonl is empty.
findings.boundary: The unsupported window geometry is observed. The exact desktop WorkArea, screen resolution and DPI were not recorded; attributing the dimensions exclusively to a physical/display limit would be an inference. Pending preview in the initial Editor layout is not evidence of a blank or stale completed preview.
findings.effect: The mandatory completion observations were not collected. No product safety, regression or visible-completion acceptance follows.

findings.finding: V3 failed exact OS appearance restoration; the launcher stopped before V4.
findings.source: Frozen qualification/windows.py:77-80 requires successful SPI call and exact appearance read-back; qualification.py:274-280 stops after cleanupVerified=false.
findings.observed: Initial appearance was flags 126/scheme empty. Final appearance was flags 126/scheme High Contrast Black. V3 records restored=false, cleanupVerified=false and restoreError=OS appearance restoration/change is unverified. All three child jobs record jobTreeEmpty=true, and initial/final heldInput are empty.
findings.boundary: The High Contrast enabled bit is off in both flags 126 values; the evidence does not show High Contrast left enabled. The changed scheme still fails the exact restoration contract. Empty job trees and released input cannot substitute for verified appearance restoration.
findings.effect: R02 is blocked independently of any product-correctness interpretation. V4 and R02 remain NOT_RUN.

findings.finding: The three PNG files are fixture assets, not failure screenshots.
findings.source: Sealed build/r01/Program.cs:106 copies build/fixtures/pixel.png before the journey.
findings.observed: All three PNGs are 68-byte 1x1 files with SHA256 a38a4ff7320a3d8764ac959b264f15e335360d7c1e23a0627dee7f366c95c58f, byte-identical to the sealed fixture. Failure records explicitly say extraCapture=false. There are zero full-frame or crop observations.
findings.effect: Independent visible-pixel review is impossible for this collection. No software presentation ordering or physical display claim is established.

findings.finding: The frozen launcher continued after V1 and V2 geometry failures because generic child exit 1 was treated as a retained process failure; the wrapper audited the batch afterwards.
findings.source: Frozen qualification.py:269-280 stops on supervision/job-tree/cleanup failure, not generic non-zero child exit; return at 283 preserves overall failure.
findings.boundary: Continuation through V2/V3 is a factual limitation of the existing supervisor's failure classification, not evidence that V1/V2 were valid product failures or that shared infrastructure was suitable. V3 cleanup failure triggered the explicit safety stop.
findings.effect: A future proposal must distinguish unmet shared preconditions before launching a subsequent cell. This review does not authorise a fix, retry or replacement cell.

findings.finding: V3's 7.893273424942036 ratio belongs only to the first probe-host palette observation.
findings.observed: The record explicitly says FIRST PROBE HOST PALETTE; distinct from the unchanged historical pre-assertion test.
findings.effect: It does not qualify R02 application controls, pressed states, propagation, native accessibility or the unchanged 4.5:1 requirement. The historical 2.542596:1 failure remains intact.

auditReplay.comparison: All verdict fields and per-cell outcomes match the original. Missing-file reason paths differ only because replay uses the extracted local directory.

Frozen scripts/native/qualification are unchanged from 77664fbe through the dispatched wrapper commit.
The uploaded coordinator has exactly 289 LF-to-CRLF conversions relative to its Git blob; no other byte difference was found. The actual Git setting itself is not separately inferred.

The recorded full host/image identity matches the discovery lock. The downloaded restore manifest exactly matches the original 2,019-file archive, including the existing source/build/runtime receipts.

The three launched processes' loaded product/Core/harness/WPF/CoreCLR hashes and product/runtime versions match the sealed bytes. Runtimeconfig pins Core and WindowsDesktop 10.0.14 with rollForward Disable.
SDK and live-host closure checks are recorded by the reviewed coordinator. This offline review checks their retained bindings and does not reconstruct the now-completed host.
minimumFutureTechnicalWork: Define a geometry-eligibility preflight that establishes the fixed 1280x800/100 percent scope before counting a process as an eligible completion observation.
Provide a bounded per-cell classification/stop path for shared precondition or infrastructure failures.
Resolve and independently validate exact appearance restoration, including scheme read-back, without weakening the existing safety contract.
Any new preparation or execution must be separately scoped and authorised by the owner. No retry, additional cell, calibration, local desktop session or R02 execution follows from this review.

High Contrast application correctness and the historical failure remain unresolved; R02 has no observations.
Historical lifecycle/selection incidents are neither closed nor explained by this unrelated startup geometry precondition failure.
